text.tspan: the driver binds to a device that already exists in DT
at module-load time, and pvz_probe runs once at insmod.
There is no IRQ, no DMA, no read() handler; just one ioctl
that does a single iowrite32 to a memory-mapped slave.
walks DT for a node whose
-> fills dev.res with the slave's phys range from DT
-> ioremap; virtbase is the kernel VA used by iowrite32
